desc:
This is a competitive game where two to four players take turns entering words that fit the theme.

[🥊] If you can't answer within the time limit, your HP will decrease. 
[🚫] The same word can only be used once. 
[💥] You will be eliminated if your HP reaches 0. The winner is the one who survives until the end.
[🌸] There are 11 different themes: animals, food, anime, countries, chain stores, buzzwords/internet slang, games, drinks, colors, school life, and festivals. 
[🎁] You can collect chair and chat appearance items from the gacha. 
[🏆] There is also a ranking, so try to aim for the top! 

👍 If you like it, please like and favorite it! 
🛠️ Updates may change the content. 
🚨 We will restrict your account if we detect any fraudulent activity.
